auth_type.description: review-15-9 F-7: 'google_direct' added as a first-class auth family (AD-21, Epic 18). The Google stack (GA4/GSC/Google Ads/Sheets) uses a single server-side OAuth consent whose encrypted token lives in app.connection_ref -- NOT Nango. This is distinct from generic 'oauth2' (Nango-brokered) so a manifest's auth_type no longer contradicts its auth.type='google_direct' block. 'basic' (woocommerce, epic-25) is a first-class family for self-hosted providers that authenticate with a STATIC key/secret pair over HTTP Basic auth and carry a per-connection base URL -- brokered by Nango (core.nango_client.get_basic_credentials), distinct from single-secret 'api_key'. Documented platform-contract evolution.

events.description: Epic 31: for a landing='context_events' profile -- the kind='event' field ids it emits (metrics/dimensions stay empty). Absent for kpi profiles.

extraction_path.description: Story 3.1: Optional extraction route. Absent = 'custom_pull' at runtime. 'airbyte_sync' triggers AirbyteClient instead of module pull().

landing.description: Epic 31: where this profile lands. Absent = derived at load (module_kind=='context' -> context_events, else fact_daily_kpi). Per-profile, so a connector may mix kpi and event profiles.

canonical_event_mapping.description: Epic 31: source event id -> canonical event_type (governed by dbt/seeds/dim_event_type.csv). Strict parallel of canonical_metric_mapping. Only meaningful for connectors declaring an event profile (landing=context_events).

oneOf.description: Schema v1.1: non-additive metric descriptor with declared aggregation_rule (AD-4). Supported rules: impression_weighted (GSC average_position), sum (additive default).

module_kind.description: Schema v1.1: 'kpi' (default) produces fact_daily_kpi rows; 'context' produces context_events rows only. DEPRECATED as a product concept (Epic 31): a connector is the sum of its profiles' 'landing' values, not a single kind. Retained only as the derivation source for a profile's default 'landing' (absent landing + module_kind=='context' -> context_events). New connectors should set 'landing' per profile; module_kind stays for backward compatibility.

quota.description: Optional per-platform quota budget. When absent, the platform has unlimited budget (no pre-check, no circuit breaker). All numeric fields must be positive integers.
